explainers.title: MAXIMUS — A Digital Twin, End to End
explainers.summary: One inbound email traced through a personal digital-twin AI — Claude as the brain, LangGraph as the nervous system, one egress door, Qdrant + markdown memory, and a Postgres spine — from webhook to the three-weeks-later flywheel where memory surfaces itself unprompted.

explainers.title: FastAPI Request Flow: Client to Response
explainers.summary: How an HTTP request travels through uvicorn, FastAPI routing, dependency injection, Pydantic validation, the path-operation function, and back out as a serialized JSON response.

explainers.title: AI Voice Agent: Inbound Call Flow (3D)
explainers.summary: How an AI voice agent handles an inbound business call end to end — real-time conversation, CRM lookup and update, scheduling, confirmation and logging — with a warm-transfer escalation branch to a human when a request is out of scope.
